stage.P0.description: Define the exact goal, scope and authorization.
stage.P1.description: Organize mathematical context, assumptions and notation.
stage.P2.description: Map relationships and potential research routes.
stage.P3.description: Choose authorized concrete work and its input scope.
stage.P4.description: Construct derivations and arguments with explicit premises.
stage.P5.description: Identify gaps between current knowledge and the target.
stage.P6.description: Reduce gaps to precise obligations and dependency scopes.
stage.P7.description: Analyze obligations using the registered independent routes.
stage.P8.description: Attempt repairs, boundary cases or counterexamples.
stage.P9.description: Independently check the exact claims and evidence scope.
stage.P10.description: Assemble compatible supported results without broadening their scope.
stage.P11.description: Account for knowledge changes, reused material and remaining gaps.
stage.P12.description: Review the whole current result against the original goal.
stage.P13.description: Write, review and deliver explicitly requested English reports.
stage.P14.description: Record the decision to continue, stop or hand off.
stage.D0.description: Preserve phenomena, immutable background and allowed exploration.
stage.D1.description: Collect positive, negative and unresolved evidence.
stage.D2.description: Generate zero or more precise candidate formulations.
stage.D3.description: Screen candidates by evidence, scope and research value.
stage.D4.description: Review candidates independently with explicit unchecked scope.
stage.D5.description: Select a candidate, request reports or prepare a paused handoff.
stage.S0.description: Declare topic, questions, inclusion, exclusion, delivery goal and budget.
stage.S1.description: Plan and execute controlled literature discovery; record queries and access limits.
stage.S2.description: Read frozen source versions and record actual sections, locators and unread scope.
stage.S3.description: Organize definitions, results, mechanisms, relations, examples and boundaries in native knowledge.
stage.S4.description: Review selected knowledge, evidence, dependency closure and coverage; route each gap precisely.
stage.S5.description: Freeze a knowledge selection and declare audience, proof commitments and the selected edition.
stage.S6.description: Write the requested English edition from frozen knowledge; return new claims for review.
stage.S7.description: Review semantics, compile, inspect every actual page, and record checked deliverables.

error.RESOURCE_WAIT: Input preparation is waiting for its memory or temporary-space reservation. Existing evidence is preserved. Wait for the active preparation to finish, then recover the original operation; do not resend an UNKNOWN request.
error.RESOURCE_DISK_LOW: There is not enough free disk space for this preparation and its safety margin. Existing evidence is preserved. Free space and recover the original operation; do not create another model request.
error.RESOURCE_LIMIT: This input exceeds the bounded preparation budget. Preserve the original evidence and explicitly narrow this scope or create a CoveragePlan. No model request should be repeated to bypass the limit.
error.RESOURCE_FILE_INVALID: A required frozen input is not a valid immutable regular file. Preparation is blocked and existing evidence is preserved. Inspect the source integrity before recovering the original operation.
error.CONTEXT_LIMIT: The complete input cannot be prepared within its verified storage or model-context limits. Preserve the evidence and explicitly narrow the selected scope or use a CoveragePlan. Inspect the diagnostic before recovering the original operation; do not resend an UNKNOWN request.
